idfm_tt.publisher: Île-de-France Mobilités, open data, network timetable (GTFS), version of 15 October 2026
idfm_tt.about: Tuesday 3 November 2026: every train of the metro, the RER, the Transilien lines and the tramways, and the TER trains inside the region, with the walking times published between platforms; read train by train for the station-to-station times

csa.publisher: J. Dibbelt, T. Pajor, B. Strasser, D. Wagner, Connection Scan Algorithm, ACM Journal of Experimental Algorithmics 23, 2018 (first published 2013)
csa.about: The method used to read a timetable for the quickest trips: every hop of every train, sorted by departure, is read once

gpe_times.publisher: Société des grands projets, « Temps de parcours intergares prévisionnels », data.gouv.fr, 2015
gpe_times.about: Run time between each pair of neighbouring stations of lines 15 South, 15 West, 16, 17 and 18, stops included; line 15 East is not in the file and takes the speed of line 15 South

gpe_stations.publisher: Île-de-France Mobilités, open data, stations and interchanges planned in Île-de-France (projets_arrets_idf), version of 31 August 2026
gpe_stations.about: Name and position of each station of lines 15, 16, 17 and 18

gpe_l15.publisher: Société des grands projets, brochure « Ligne 15 », July 2024, page 3
gpe_l15.about: At the peak a train every 2 to 3 minutes; average speed between 55 and 65 km/h

gpe_dates.publisher: Sortir à Paris, « Grand Paris Express: the new timetable for lines 15, 16, 17 and 18 », 30 September 2026 (press)
gpe_dates.about: Opening dates announced on 24 September 2026: line 18 from December 2026 to 2030, line 15 South in autumn 2027, line 16 in 2028 and 2029, line 17 from 2028 to 2030, line 15 West and East in 2031

transitous.publisher: Transitous, public journey planner (MOTIS router), read on 15 November 2026
transitous.about: Quickest trip leaving after 8:00 on Tuesday 17 November 2026 for 30 pairs of stations, by metro, train and tramway, from the timetable of Île-de-France Mobilités; used to check the times calculated on today's network
